brand.name: Mareo
brand.aestheticCommitment: Mareo furnishes small Japanese homes with plain, well-made sofas: navy actions on the warm cream of its own product photography, one terracotta accent taken from the fabric range, Japanese text set with room to breathe, and nothing on the page that does not help someone choose.
brand.audience: Adults in Japan furnishing a one- or two-room home, choosing a sofa on a phone

type.display: Jost, 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif
type.body: 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif
type.discipline: Jost only for the MAREO wordmark and Latin product names; every Japanese string in the Japanese stack at line-height 1.7, tracking 0 to +0.02em, with phrase-aware line breaks (word-break: auto-phrase, keep-all fallback)
